records.prompt: Create ONE single idle game sprite of a Russian late17th-century-inspired MOUNTED MUSKETEER. Use image1 for the exact directly-overhead horse-and-rider camera, anatomy, pose and smooth painted style; use image2 for the Russian musket, kaftan, fur-edged cap and powder gear. Horse faces BOTTOM, tail TOP, crown of rider's cap visible with strongly foreshortened torso and no face. Same lean bay/dun horse, black mane and tail, brown leather harness and riding saddle. Rider wears a long muted deep russet-red kaftan with small brass front closures, narrow cream/gold trim, brown fur-edged red cap, leather belt, powder flask and a small ammunition bandolier, buff trousers and brown riding boots. NO medieval lamellar, steel helmet or horse barding. Remove bow, arrows and quiver. Give him an EARLY MUSKET: clearly continuous long straight iron barrel, shaped walnut buttstock, visible lock mechanism and trigger guard, ramrod under barrel. Hold musket at REST in rider's RIGHT hand (screen-left), hand grasping wooden stock near lock with butt resting at right thigh; barrel angled gently toward top-left beside rider and horse, no aimed firing pose. Left hand(screen-right) holds reins. Sheathed sabre at hip can remain. Equipment should look handmade but serviceable, consistent with the existing Russian sprites, controlled texture no grain or exaggerated black outline. Entire mounted actor and complete musket centered uncropped on transparent RGBA1024x1536portrait canvas with clear margins. No background, halo, cast shadow, text, watermark, bayonet, modern rifle, scope or tricorne. This is one relaxed idle review frame, no animation sheet.
